title: Hearty Syrian Lamb Kebabs
description: A traditional Syrian dish featuring lamb, horseradish, and nuka-pickle, this recipe is perfect for adventurous eaters, this fatty and chewy kebab is a gluten-free friendly option
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, salt, black pepper, and sumac.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lamb is cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the kebabs are cooking, mix the grated horseradish and chopped nuka-pickle in a small bowl.
Once the kebabs are done, let them rest for a few minutes before serving with the horseradish and nuka-pickle mixture.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
